name: fin-news-assistant — v1 thin orchestrator

parameters.command: python3 -c "import sqlite3,os; db=os.getenv('DB_PATH','data/fin_news.db'); import pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(db); print('active' if not p.exists() else (sqlite3.connect(db).execute(\"SELECT value FROM status WHERE key='feature_flag'\").fetchone() or ['active'])[0])"
parameters.notes: If read_only (exam week) downstream Execute steps should be disabled via IF node.

nodes.name: Run flash_xau → ingest → resolver → flash_notify → validate → agent_pm

parameters.command: python3 src/flash_xau.py --limit 15 && python3 src/ingest.py --limit 10 --symbols USD,XAU && python3 src/resolver.py --limit 50 && python3 src/flash_notify.py --limit 10 && python3 src/validate.py --limit 50 && python3 src/agent_pm.py --limit 50 --post-discord
parameters.notes: Fable 2026-10-12: flash_xau (InvestingLive RSS + FF Calendar, 0 keys) → ingest → resolver → flash_notify (second webhook DISCORD_FLASH_WEBHOOK_URL, FREE heuristic, before validate/agent_pm) → validate → agent_pm. Thin orchestrator only.

notes: Deploy: Linux gateway 24/7 (systemd timer 08:00 Asia/Kuala_Lumpur) or n8n Docker. Chain: flash_xau → ingest → resolver → flash_notify (DISCORD_FLASH_WEBHOOK_URL) → validate → agent_pm. See fin-news.service.
